infrastructure.detail: Bolt GCP organization numeric id, parent of project bolt-finance-rides (887149548285). Source: cloudresourcemanager projects.get as fenti, receipt gcp-clientauth-harvest/raw/crm_project_get.json.

fenti holds apikeys.keys.* grants but the service is off: v2 list at projects/887149548285/locations/global/keys returns 403 'API Keys API has not been used in project... or it is disabled'. Read blocked until enabled (write action, out of read-only scope) or until a X-Goog-User-Project override against a project where it IS enabled + serviceusage.services.use.

facts: GFE-404 (unrouted): /v1/organizations/{org}/clients, /v1beta1/organizations/{org}/clients, /v1/projects/{n}/clients — general OAuth client enumeration is NOT publicly routable in org or project shape; the Cloud Console Credentials page uses an internal RPC surface.
403 unregistered callers: /$discovery/rest requires API consumer identity (API key) — cannot bootstrap discovery without one.

Documented routable (NOT yet probed, next lane): /v1/projects/{n}/brands (list) and /v1/projects/{n}/brands/{brand}/identityAwareProxyClients (list/get-with-secret semantics). This is the remaining public path where clientauthconfig.clients.getWithSecret could still pay out (IAP clients carry secrets).
Cost warning: this lane burned 4 of 8 calls on shape discovery — do not repeat.

technique_notes.fact: GET https://apikeys.googleapis.com/v2/projects/{projectNumber}/locations/global/keys (NOT projects/{p}/keys — that parent 404s). v1 alternative: apikeys.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{p}/keys (legacy Simple API Key view).
